Class EventListVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.CardVisitor
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.events.EventListVisitor
public class EventListVisitor extends CardVisitor
A visitor that collects specific event cards into a provided list. It is used to filter or group events from a larger collection of cards.
